title: Pressure Reveals Character: Behavioural Alignment Evaluation at Depth
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures general behavioral alignment across six categories: Honesty, Safety, Non-Manipulation, Robustness, Corrigibility, and Scheming.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
